text_block_list.text:
One day, Tazuna-san shared some cupcakes 
with me.

When I visited the classroom to share some 
with Tokai Teio as well—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's Trainer! What's up~?

Besides Tokai Teio, it seemed Mejiro 
McQueen, Daiwa Scarlet, and Vodka were 
also still in the classroom.

Since I had the chance, I decided to bring 
them some refreshments as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, there are so many flavors! Which one 
should I get~♪ I can't decide~
choice_data_list:
Everyone, go ahead and take whatever you 
like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. In that case, I shall 
take the chestnuts...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll have strawberry. Thank you very much, 
Teio's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well then, guess I'll take some chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? I was just about to pick that one 
too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that's too bad. You were one step 
too late.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh! Trainer brought refreshments for 
*me*!
choice_data_list: We can just split it in half.
We should just settle it with a match.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

If we split the chocolate flavor and the 
remaining vanilla flavor, we get to enjoy 
two flavors, so it's a great deal.

When I tell her that, Tokai Teio's eyes 
immediately light up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I see! Trainer, that's a brilliant idea!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Works for me! The vanilla one looks tasty 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Me too~♪ Let's split it in half then!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! The chocolate and vanilla both 
smell so good~♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sharing, huh? That might be a good idea. 
Hey, McQueen-san, why don't we split half 
and half too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, gladly♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho~... Looking closely, McQueen's looks 
delicious too♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, can I have some too? Just one 
bite is fine~! C'mon, pleeease!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, fine, I understand...! Only for a 
little bit, alright?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay~♪ Time to dig in~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, that wasn't 'just a bite' at all~?!

After Tokai Teio was put in high spirits 
from eating the cupcakes, she proceeded 
to—

We were able to head into training in high 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! Let's settle this, 
Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Bring it on! What are we competing in?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Time for the President's Quiz, then!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoever gets the most questions right on 
this quiz about Prez wins!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Denied, denied! I don't really know much 
about the President anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If we need quiz topics, let's make it 
about bikes! Motorbikes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh?! Then I won't know what's going on 
at all!!
choice_data_list: Why not settle it fairly with a race?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: That's it!!

No sooner had they said it than the two of 
them scrambled out of the classroom, each 
trying to be first.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... Sorry about our Vodka, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What should we do with this cupcake? It 
seems both of them have completely 
forgotten about it, though...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Please take care of 
those two, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... I made it here first!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No way! I was faster!

Though the two fought a heated battle, it 
seems no victor was decided.

After that, the two competed in various 
contests, but it seems it was ultimately 
settled with a game of 
rock-paper-scissors.

"...And just as expected, she had 
completely forgotten about the cupcake."

All in all, this match must have been a 
great experience for Tokai Teio.
